+function fcOwnEntryAnyV1288(ch) {
+  const uid = state.profile?.id;
+  if (!uid || !ch) return null;
+  const rows = [
+    ...(state.challengeEntriesV1060 || []),
+    ...(state.feedEntries || []),

+  ];

+    String(e?.user_id || '') === String(uid)
